_doc: Spatial audio recipe for Godot 4.5. Per research/E2_audio_local_ambience.md §3.2: Godot 4.5 has no built-in HRTF; the community godot-resonance-audio GDExtension is the cleanest path but ships native binaries (Windows/Linux/macOS). This recipe documents the install + verify command but does NOT install the extension (out of scope for the audio pipeline; the operator decides when to add a native binary dep).
install_steps: 1. Download the latest release from the upstream GitHub releases page
2. Unzip into res://addons/godot-resonance-audio/ (creates the .gdextension manifest + per-platform .dll/.so)
3. Restart Godot; check Project Settings -> Plugins shows godot-resonance-audio enabled
4. Add a single ResonanceAudioListener node as child of the camera/player (acts as the HRTF listener)
5. Replace AudioStreamPlayer3D with ResonanceAudioSource for sounds you want HRTF-spatialized

6. The ambience pack's bed_drone / bed_air STAY on AudioStreamPlayer (non-spatial). Only sweeteners (wildlife_sparse / distant_event one-shots) benefit from HRTF. Update BiomeAmbienceController.gd to instantiate ResonanceAudioSource on supported platforms, with AudioStreamPlayer3D as fallback.

use_cases.first_person: Highest payoff. HRTF gives convincing front/back/up/down localization in headphones.
use_cases.third_person_iso: Marginal. Iso/top-down camera disconnects listener from audio anyway. Skip.
use_cases.third_person_over_shoulder: Moderate. Useful for stealth audio cues. Worth enabling per-platform-toggle.

fallback.behavior: BiomeAmbienceController falls back to AudioStreamPlayer3D with attenuation_model=AudioServer.ATTENUATION_INVERSE_DISTANCE. Spatial cues still work, just not HRTF-quality.

non_options_considered.Steam_Audio: Apache-2.0 license, but no Godot 4.5 binding maintained as of 2026-05. Watch upstream.
non_options_considered.Wwise_Spatial_Audio: Free under $250K revenue; integrates via the Wwise Godot 4 plugin. Heavier dependency. Park for shipping milestone.
non_options_considered.FMOD_Studio_Resonance: Free under $200K revenue; requires FMOD Studio license + Godot FMOD integration. Same heavyweight tradeoff as Wwise.
